work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Single outer Clement XII act extending provisions of an earlier constitution, with current protocol 74377-74378, explicit introduction 74384-74432 of prior material, quoted provisions through 74822, and outer petition/resumption at 74824 followed by extension 74871-74880. Prior popes named within the recitation and earlier constitution are not current issuers. The broken synopsis continues after running header 74369 at 74371-74375 and remains included in the selected extent. All historical note blocks are retained: 74434-74437, 74490-74492, 74552-74554, 74600-74603, 74662-74668, 74716-74722, 74774-74778, 74840-74841, and 74904-74909; the references and correction notes have internal membership. Retains full final clauses and dating 75038-75041 plus printed date 75043. Previous act ends 74356; next independent heading begins 75046. No unresolved apparatus membership. Source-extent re-audit: the backward references at 74434-74435 and in the historical notes identify the earlier constitution and locations of its expressly selected quoted provisions (introduced 74427-74432); they do not replace the substantive body of this present extending act. The current act contains its own petition, extension, conditions and closing clauses. No unresolved substantive omission or abbreviated terminal formula was found.
